title: Finding and installing usage specs
description:
Ever seen an AI coding agent misuse an open-source library? It's a common problem that stems from a lack of context. This quick demo shows how Tessl's Spec Driven Development provides the solution.

Watch as we use the Tessl Spec Registry to find and install a "usage spec" for the fastmcp library. This simple step downloads all the necessary information about the library's APIs and intended usage, giving the agent the vital context it needs to code accurately and effectively.

Stop scaling mediocrity and start providing your AI agents with the knowledge they need to succeed.
